texts.preamble: T.Selvamurugan vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 6 June, 2023 Author: M.S.Ramesh Bench: M.S. Ramesh W.P.No.26930 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 06.06.2023 Coram The Honourable Mr. Justice M.S. Ramesh W.P.No.26930 of 2022 and W.M.P.Nos.26135 & 26138 of 2022 T.Selvamurugan ...Petitioner Vs. 1.The State of Tamil Nadu, Rep. by its Principal Secretary, Health and Family Welfare Department, Fort St. George, Chennai - 600 009. 2.The Commissioner of Food Safety, Tamil Nadu Food Safety & Drug Administration Department, No.359, Anna Salai, Chennai - 600 006. 3.The Director, Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Teynampet, Chennai. 4.The Member Secretary, Medical Services Recruitment Board (Mrb), Teynampet, Chennai - 600 008.
texts.facts: The written examination was also conducted in the month of November, 2021. Though the petitioner had filed the present Writ Petition even before the last date of submission of the application, much water has flown under the bridge.
